finding: With no key, no account, no wallet and no payment, a POST of {"query":"test"} to https://api.exa.ai/search, the REST search endpoint behind the Exa MCP server, answered HTTP 402 on 2026-10-03 at 18:24:02Z with two machine-payment protocols in one response: an x402 version 2 document with seven accepts entries, each scheme exact at 7000 units of USDC (the vendor's page says $0.007) on Base, Solana, World Chain or Arc, and a Machine Payments Protocol challenge (WWW-Authenticate: Payment, method tempo, intent charge, chain id 4217). The vendor documents both protocols for /search and /contents in its own words, naming Base and Solana; the wire also offers World Chain and Arc. The same request answered the same way on 2026-10-04. The MCP endpoint itself drew no 402 keyless: the free, rate-limited mode and the pay-per-request mode are two doors to one index. No payment was made, so what follows payment is not measured. One IP is one sample.
